info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listValidators returns the caller org's claimed validator slots, each with its
get.description:
listValidators returns the caller org's claimed validator slots, each with its
node status and its queued registration.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means 200 and nothing above 1000 is honoured.

post.summary:
provisionValidator claims a slot: it verifies the signature and on-chain NFT
ownership, generates a luxd staking identity into KMS, writes the node CR and
ENQUEUES an owner-gated registration.
post.description:
provisionValidator claims a slot: it verifies the signature and on-chain NFT
ownership, generates a luxd staking identity into KMS, writes the node CR and
ENQUEUES an owner-gated registration. It fails CLOSED at every gate — bad
signature, non-owner, non-tier, KMS unavailable — none of which persist a claim
or leak key material. Re-claiming a slot this org already holds re-applies the
CR without regenerating keys.

get.summary:
issueChallenge issues a single-use, org-bound nonce and the EXACT message the
caller must personal_sign.
get.description:
issueChallenge issues a single-use, org-bound nonce and the EXACT message the
caller must personal_sign. Binding the nonce to (org, slot) here means a
signature can never be replayed for a different org, slot, or session.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: TokenID is the GenesisNFT id of the slot; it IS the validator slot number.

get.summary: getValidator returns one of the caller org's claimed slots.
get.description:
getValidator returns one of the caller org's claimed slots. A slot held by
another org reads as not found.

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: TokenID is the GenesisNFT id of the slot; it IS the validator slot number.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is the unix second after which the nonce is refused.

message.description: Message is the exact text the wallet must personal_sign, byte for byte.

nonce.description: Nonce is the single-use value bound to (org, slot); claiming burns it.

tokenId.description: TokenID echoes the slot the challenge is bound to.

ttlSeconds.description: TTLSeconds is the lifetime the nonce was issued with.

nonce.description: Nonce is the value issued by GET /v1/validators/challenge. Required.

signature.description: Signature is the wallet's personal_sign over the challenge message. Required.

tokenId.description: TokenID is the Validator-tier GenesisNFT id being claimed. Required.

nodeID.description: NodeID is the node the registration would add.

status.description: Status is the queue state; new registrations are pending_owner_approval.

data.description: Data is the page of claimed slots; empty when the org has claimed none.

network.description: Network is the network slug new nodes join (mainnet/testnet/devnet/localnet).

blsPubkey.description: BLSPubkey is the node's BLS public key, hex-encoded.

crName.description: CRName is the LuxNetwork custom resource written for the node.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is unix seconds, server-assigned at claim time.

namespace.description: Namespace is the cluster namespace the node CR lives in.

network.description: Network is the network slug the node syncs.

nodeID.description: NodeID is the luxd node identity generated for the slot.

nodeStatus.description: NodeStatus is provisioning, node_created or node_pending (no cluster reached).

registration.description: Registration is the queued, owner-gated P-Chain registration; absent until enqueued.

slot.description: Slot is the validator slot number (the same value as tokenId).

tokenId.description: TokenID is the GenesisNFT id that entitles the slot.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is unix seconds of the last status change.

wallet.description: Wallet is the lower-cased address that proved ownership of the NFT.
